title: Sable and the Echo
author: R. M. Montrose
blurb: Lena Villalobos, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
